thread:
deploy-bot: Rollout request: Catalina Systems -> Dedicated (us-east-1). Window: 2027-01-12 07:00-08:30 UTC. Serving image pinned to v4.2.0 (sha: 1a2b3c). Canary plan: 2% -> 10% -> 40% -> 100% with 12m checks. Rollback pinned to v4.1.6. Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/catalina-dedicated-rollout

zoe (eng-release): Heads-up: this release includes an opt-in prompt-template toggle and a small DB migration (no schema drift, just index rebuild). Migration is staged: pre-copy at T-40m, final sync during 40%->100% window. Warmup job scheduled T-22m to seed KV and prompt caches.

rahul (sre): SRE gates: p95 <= 140ms, errors <0.5%, token99 <= 520ms, and DB replication lag < 3s. Because migration touches indexes, require a DB snapshot at T-55m. Ops confirmed snapshot feasible?

dave (cs): Catalina ops confirmed snapshot and will run it at 06:05 UTC (T-55m). They also want a 15m readonly notice during final sync and an API redirect fallback ready.

emily (pm): Product sign-off conditional on Compliance thumbs-up. Catalina requires data residency assertion for logs retained <30d. Add that to release notes. Also request a 20-minute rollback decision window after 40% ramp.

compliance-bot: Compliance check: data_retention_policy=30d flagged in runbook notes? Not yet. Please add: "logs_retention=30d; access_audit=enabled". Also request audit trail for who flips the prompt-template toggle.

zoe (eng-release): Added policy text to runbook and release notes. Toggle will be gated behind feature-flag `catalina.prompt_opt_in`. We will not flip flag automatically; customer must opt-in post-deploy. Documented in runbook step 6.

rahul (sre): Auto-rollback gates set to p95, error_rate, 5xx, token99, db_lag. If any gate breaches for 2 consecutive checks, auto-rollback to v4.1.6. Manual rollback command registered:

```
redwood-deploy rollback --tenant=catalina --to=v4.1.6 --reason=canary-gate
```

rahul (sre): Also adding a manual "emergency-hold" token process if we need to pause mid-ramp. Who owns the manual hold?

zoe (eng-release): Eng-release owns the hold. We'll add a hold token in the runbook and a quick command: `deployctl hold --token=HOLD-<id>` to pause ramps.

dave (cs): CS confirmed customer ok with readonly banner and will prep API redirect. I'll send final reminder at 06:30 UTC.

emily (pm): I will run Go/No-go at 06:35 UTC. Catalina asked for a 30-minute post-deploy verification window before we mark as complete. Add that to checklist.

compliance-bot: Compliance approves with the added notes and audit hooks. Please ensure audit logs are exported to tenant-s3/catalina/audit/2027-01-12.

deploy-bot: When ready reply with "approve" to lock window. Reminder ping scheduled at 06:00 UTC to @emily (pm), @dave (cs), @rahul (sre), @zoe (eng-release).

zoe (eng-release): approve (locking window).

rahul (sre): approve.

emily (pm): approve. I'll do Go/No-go.

compliance-bot: approve from compliance side. Audit export scheduled in runbook.

deploy-bot: Window locked. Canary will start at 07:00 UTC. Links: logs: https://logs.redwood/catalina/5109876543, runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/catalina-dedicated-rollout, rollback guide: https://redwood-internal/playbooks/rollback-guides#catalina

zoe (eng-release): I'll post phase updates during ramps and keep the thread updated if we need to engage the hold token. RahuI, please call rollback if gates fail. :thumbsup:
